android.extraProguardRules:
# BOA HUB: R8 renames and shrinks everything not kept below. React Native, Expo modules (ours included), Agora, Firebase and Reanimated ship their own consumer rules; these cover the gaps.
# Readable crash stack traces, without real source file names.
-keepattributes SourceFile,LineNumberTable,*Annotation*
-renamesourcefileattribute SourceFile
# jail-monkey (device integrity TurboModule, looked up by name).
-keep class com.gantix.JailMonkey.** { *; }
# Agora video calls: the SDK and its React bridge call into each other by name.
-keep class io.agora.** { *; }
-dontwarn io.agora.**
# WebView JavaScript bridges (YouTube player, web content).
-keepclassmembers class * { @android.webkit.JavascriptInterface <methods>; }
# Optional TLS and annotation classes that libraries reference but don't need.
-dontwarn org.conscrypt.**
-dontwarn org.bouncycastle.**
-dontwarn org.openjsse.**
-dontwarn javax.annotation.**
-dontwarn com.google.errorprone.annotations.**
